narr: Ample moisture from Tropical Storm/Hurricane Eta to the south over the Gulf of Mexico, marginal instability and moderate shear combined to produce isolated wind damage and flooding across portions of north and central Georgia ahead of a cold front sweeping through the region.
ev: The Emergency Manager reported water flowing over White Road and other nearby roadways due to rising water from neighboring creeks. Several fields and pastures were also inundated. Radar estimates indicate that 1.5 to 2.5 inches of rain fell quickly over the area, causing the flash flooding.

The Emergency Manager reported flooding near the intersection of Edwards Street and Coombs Avenue. Radar estimates indicate that 4 to 6 inches of rain occurred in the area, producing the flash flooding.
The Emergency Manager reported flooding along Ivey Drive, resulting in its closure. Radar estimates indicate that 4 to 6 inches of rain occurred in the area, producing the flash flooding.

The Emergency Manager reported flooding on Cut Thru Road due to high water conditions in Little Rocky Creek. Radar estimates indicate that 4 to 6 inches of rain occurred over the area, producing excessive runoff and resulting in the flash flooding.
